title: Ordinary scalar mate and tensor pullback on module sheaves
statement: Let $f:Z\to T$ be a scheme morphism, $a:A\to B$ a map of commutative ring sheaves on the small pro-etale site of $T$. Put $A_Z=f^{-1}A$, $B_Z=f^{-1}B$, $a_Z=f^{-1}a$. Let $F_A,F_B$ be the fixed module pullbacks, $E_a,E_{a_Z}$ the normalized ordinary scalar extensions, $r_T,r_Z$ scalar restriction, and $b:F_A r_T\cong r_Z F_B$ the fixed restriction comparison [lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction]. Write $C_a=r_TB$ and $C_{a_Z}=r_ZB_Z$ for the restricted regular modules. Let $o_a:r_TE_a\cong(-\otimes_A C_a)$ and $o_{a_Z}$ be the pure-tensor-normalized ordinary comparisons [lem-sfb-scalar-tensor-ordinary-normalization], and $k:F_AC_a\cong C_{a_Z}$ the fixed coefficient pullback [lem-sfb-derived-scalar-tensor-identification]. Suppose $\chi:F_BE_a\cong E_{a_Z}F_A$ satisfies $F_A(\eta_a(M));b_{E_aM};r_Z(\chi_M)=\eta_{a_Z}(F_AM)$ for every module $M$. Then, for every $A$-module sheaf $M$, $b_{E_aM};r_Z(\chi_M);o_{a_Z}(F_AM)=F_A(o_a(M));\mu_{M,C_a};(1\otimes k)$, where $\mu:F_A(M\otimes_A N)\cong F_AM\otimes_{A_Z}F_AN$ is the canonical ordinary tensor pullback [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. No flatness or derived-category hypothesis occurs.

proof.text: Normalize the chosen pullback of the regular B-module by comparison with the standard pullback/pushforward adjunction. proof.text: Use the assumed scalar unit equation and naturality of the geometric inverse-image unit to compute chi on the unit image of 1 tensor m. The restriction mate takes the geometric unit for A to the geometric unit for B. B_Z-linearity of chi and semilinearity of the geometric unit extend the result to every local b tensor m.

proof.text: Transpose both routes by the geometric inverse-image adjunction and test them on local pure tensors generating the sheafified scalar extension. The ordinary extension/tensor normalization, the preceding chi formula, the pure-section specification of ordinary tensor pullback, and the coefficient formula all give pullback(m) tensor pullback(b). Sheafification and adjunction injectivity give the asserted module equality.

theorem scalarMate_ordinary_module_route {Z T : Scheme.{u}} (f : Z ⟶ T)
    {A B : Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) CommRingCat.{u + 1}} (a : A ⟶ B)
    (χ : proEtaleRingExtension a ⋙
      proEtaleRingModulePullback f B (inverseRing f B) (Iso.refl _) ≅
      proEtaleRingModulePullback f A (inverseRing f A) (Iso.refl _) ⋙
        proEtaleRingExtension (inverseMap f a))
    (hχ : ∀ M, (proEtaleRingModulePullback f A (inverseRing f A) (Iso.refl _)).map
        ((proEtaleRingExtensionAdjunction a).unit.app M) ≫
      (proEtaleRingRestrictionPullbackInv f A B (inverseRing f A) (inverseRing f B)
        a (inverseMap f a) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (by simp)).app
          ((proEtaleRingExtension a).obj M) ≫
      (restriction (inverseMap f a)).map (χ.hom.app M) =
      (proEtaleRingExtensionAdjunction (inverseMap f a)).unit.app
        ((proEtaleRingModulePullback f A (inverseRing f A) (Iso.refl _)).obj M))
    (M : proEtaleRingModules T A) :
    (proEtaleRingRestrictionPullbackInv f A B (inverseRing f A) (inverseRing f B)
      a (inverseMap f a) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (by simp)).app
        ((proEtaleRingExtension a).obj M) ≫
      (restriction (inverseMap f a)).map (χ.hom.app M) ≫
      (ordinaryTensorIso (inverseMap f a)).hom.app
        ((proEtaleRingModulePullback f A (inverseRing f A) (Iso.refl _)).obj M) =
    (proEtaleRingModulePullback f A (inverseRing f A) (Iso.refl _)).map
        ((ordinaryTensorIso a).hom.app M) ≫
      (proEtaleOrdinaryTensorPullback f A (inverseRing f A) (Iso.refl _)
        M (coefficient a)).hom ≫
      ((proEtaleOrdinaryTensor Z (inverseRing f A)).obj
        ((proEtaleRingModulePullback f A (inverseRing f A) (Iso.refl _)).obj M)).map
          (coefficientPullback f a).hom
